outcomes.promptInjectionBlocked: A pattern attempting to override system instructions or security controls was detected, so no source or model was invoked.

outcomes.sourceUnavailable: An entitled source is temporarily unavailable, so the answer was withheld.
outcomes.evidenceInsufficient: There was not enough supporting evidence, so the answer was explicitly withheld.
outcomes.modelRefused: The model refused or failed the grounding contract, so the answer was withheld.
outcomes.safeFallback: The request ended without a verified answer. Try again later.
